unresolvedReviewBreakdown.note: The earlier figure of 1968 unmatched dedicated rows was NOT 1968 of the 1328 strong candidates. After the identity pass, REVIEW_REQUIRED lumped leftover unmatched LIKELY dedicated (~900) together with the entire 1146 first-pass REVIEW rows (off-consumption licences whose premises names do not prove a dedicated bottle store). Those 1146 were never in the auto-import set. This pass reprocessed only unmatched LIKELY dedicated rows.

integrity.note: Absence from WCLA is never deletion. Snapshot is loadCatalog 5789 before the address-geocode pass (112 OSM + 4 curated + 5616 Google + 48 ECLB + 9 WCLA). After: 5789 - 9 + 722 = 6502. Distance is not identity. Different fascias in one centre stay as separate pins.
